title: Enterprise request governance and preflight network checklist for Private deployments
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: create a repeatable governance checklist and gating process for non-bug enterprise requests for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments. Scope includes: preflight networking validation (ports, egress, DNS, proxy, TLS), upgrade compatibility guidance, packaging constraints for air-gapped installs, prioritization rubric, and a lightweight sign-off flow for Security and Platform PMs. Goal: reduce back-and-forth during intake, accelerate time-to-yes for enterprise customers, and reduce misconfigured deployments that lead to delayed rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: A concise preflight checklist published in Confluence that covers networking, certs, and proxy requirements
A scoring rubric for prioritizing requests (security, customer revenue, complexity, SLA risk) documented and used by intake team
A simple upgrade-compatibility matrix covering supported OS, container runtimes, and recommended maintenance windows
Air-gapped packaging guidelines describing minimum artifacts, signing, and manual transfer steps
A gated sign-off template that includes Security and Platform approvals and an automated tracker (spreadsheet or dashboard)
comments: 2025-02-28 Maya Chen: Initial ticket created after three enterprise trial customers reported multi-week delays due to missing network expectations. Draft scope attached to Confluence link.

2025-03-03 PM sync: Proposed prioritization rubric that weights revenue and SLA risk higher during initial launch windows; agreed to trial rubric on three inbound requests this week.

2025-03-05 Liam O'Connor: Draft checklist posted to Confluence for stakeholder feedback. Action items: (1) ENG to validate port list in staging (ENG-3010), (2) Docs to add example firewall templates, (3) Security to provide sign-off template.
decision_logs: Adopted a lightweight scoring rubric (0-10 per axis) instead of a heavy ticket field approach to keep intake fast for PM/AE teams.
Will require formal security sign-off only for ‘high’ risk (network exposure, KMS integration) requests; ‘medium’ and ‘low’ can use automated checklist confirmation.

Upgrade gating: require testing against prior minor and patch versions for Dedicated customers; for on-prem customers with strict maintenance windows, offer a deferred upgrade path documented in the intake response.

Dependence on ENG tickets (ENG-2741/3010) may delay rollout of the checklist
